The official pricing policy is the 2026 pricing schedule, effective June 1, 2026, which fully supersedes and replaces the deprecated 2025 pricing proposal [NL-003#NL-003-S08]. The deprecated proposal was drafted in late 2025, never fully adopted, and is preserved only for historical comparison [NL-004#NL-004-S01][NL-004#NL-004-S02].

Key differences between the deprecated 2025 proposal and the official 2026 schedule:

- **Starter Plan**: Deprecated 2025 was $900/month with a $1,500 onboarding fee [NL-004#NL-004-S02]. Official 2026 pricing increased this to $1,200/month, with the onboarding fee adjusted to $2,500 [NL-004#NL-004-S05].
- **Growth Plan**: Deprecated 2025 was $2,800/month with a $4,500 onboarding fee [NL-004#NL-004-S02]. Official 2026 pricing increased this to $3,600/month, with the onboarding fee adjusted to $7,500 [NL-004#NL-004-S05].
- **Enterprise Plan**: Deprecated 2025 started at $6,000/month with onboarding from $10,000 [NL-004#NL-004-S02]. Official 2026 pricing increased the starting rate to $8,500/month, with onboarding adjusted to a minimum of $15,000 [NL-004#NL-004-S05].

The 2025 proposal was rejected because it was financially unsustainable, driven by underestimated infrastructure costs, heavy scanned-PDF/OCR processing costs, permission-mapping complexity, and higher-than-expected support escalations [NL-004#NL-004-S04]. The 2026 schedule is the sole source of truth for all sales, renewals, and audits [NL-003#NL-003-S01]. Deprecated 2025 rates may not be quoted to prospects, and historical contracts must migrate to 2026 rates upon renewal, though customers may run out their current active term [NL-004#NL-004-S05][NL-004#NL-004-S01]. A transition grace period may apply in some cases, such as a one-time 90-day period billing Growth at a mid-tier rate of $3,100/month instead of the full $3,600/month, subject to approval and usage requirements [NL-003#NL-003-S08].
